أَحْمَد.en: Ahmad — a proper name on the verb pattern أَفْعَل, hence a diptote

أَخْطَأَ.en: to err, to miss the mark (Form IV; أَخْطَأَ يُخْطِئُ)

عَالِم.en: a learned man, a scholar (ism fa'il of عَلِمَ; pl. عُلَمَاء)

عَمْرو.en: ʿAmr — a man's name; written with a silent waw to tell it from ʿUmar

ذَكَرَ.en: to mention; (here) to speak of with blame

فَارِس.en: Fāris — Persia, the land of the Persians (a foreign name, a diptote)

حَلْقَة.en: a ring, a circle; a study circle gathered round a teacher (pl. حَلَقَات)

حَمَّاد.en: Ḥammād — a man's name; here Ḥammād ibn Salama, the Basran master of ḥadīth with whom Sībawayh first studied

حَتَّى.en: until; even; (before idha) opening a clause

عِنْدَ.en: at, with (adverb of place and time)

جَمَعَ.en: to gather, to bring together (جَمَعَ يَجْمَعُ)

الْخَلِيل.en: al-Khalīl b. Aḥmad (d. 175/791), Sībawayh's teacher, the founder of ʿarūḍ

لَ (لَامُ الْجَوَابِ).en: the lam opening the jawab of law (and the oath)

لَمْ.en: did not (negates, jazm, turns the tense back)

لِ (التَّعْلِيل).en: the lam of cause — «so that», followed by a mansub mudari

لَقَب.en: a byname, a title by which a person is known (pl. أَلْقَاب)

لَزِمَ.en: to be binding upon, to cleave to

نَحْو.en: grammar — the science by which the iʿrāb of words and the joining of a sentence are known (عِلْمُ النَّحْوِ)

رَدَّ.en: to answer, refute; to return (doubled: رَدَّ يَرُدُّ)

سَلَمَة.en: Salama — a man's name (here the father of Ḥammād ibn Salama); a diptote, being a name with the feminine ta

سِيبَوَيْهِ.en: Sibawayh — the great grammarian (d. c. 796); his name is a Persian sound-compound

زَالَ (مَا زَالَ).en: (with ما) to keep on, never cease

الْخَطِيبُ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ.en: al-Khaṭīb al-Baghdādī — Abū Bakr Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī (d. 463 / 1071), the ḥadīth scholar who wrote Tārīkh Baghdād

أَرْبَعُونَ.en: forty (declines by letters like the sound masculine plural: أَرْبَعِينَ in nasb and jarr)

بَغْدَاد.en: Baghdad — the ʿAbbāsid capital on the Tigris (a diptote: a feminine proper name)

بَغْدَادِيّ.en: of Baghdad, a Baghdadi (the nisba of بَغْدَاد)

بَاتَ.en: to remain (by night), to pass the night — a sister of kāna (hollow)

بِلَاد.en: lands, a country (the plural of بَلَد)

دَوْلَة.en: dominion, fortune that turns; a state

دِجْلَة.en: the Tigris (a diptote: a feminine proper name)

دُنْيَا.en: this world — «the nearest» (feminine tafdil of دُنُوّ)

حَكَى.en: to tell; to resemble, to match (حَكَى يَحْكِي; naqis)

هِجْرَة.en: emigration; الْهِجْرَةُ: the Prophet's emigration to Medina, from which the Islamic years are counted (لِلْهِجْرَةِ: AH)

جَامِع.en: gathering (the active participle of جَمَعَ); الْمَسْجِدُ الْجَامِعُ: the congregational mosque, where the Friday prayer is held (pl. جَوَامِع)

خَضْرَاء.en: green (the feminine of أَخْضَر, a diptote)

خَطِيب.en: a preacher — the one who gives the Friday sermon (khuṭba) from the minbar

خُرَاسَان.en: Khurāsān — the great eastern province of the caliphate (a diptote)

مَدِينَةُ السَّلَامِ.en: Madīnat al-Salām, «the City of Peace» — the name al-Manṣūr gave his round city, Baghdad

الْمَنْصُور.en: al-Manṣūr — Abū Jaʿfar ʿAbd Allāh al-Manṣūr (d. 158 / 775), the second ʿAbbāsid caliph and the founder of Baghdad; the title means «the one granted victory»

صَنْعَة.en: a craft, the making of something

الطَّبَرِيّ.en: al-Ṭabarī — Muḥammad ibn Jarīr al-Ṭabarī (d. 310 / 923), the historian and Qurʾān commentator who lived in Baghdad; a nisba to Ṭabaristān

وَضَعَ.en: to set down, to assign (a word to a meaning)

عَمْر.en: life — the form kept for oaths: لَعَمْرِي «by my life» (its predicate «is my oath» is always left unsaid)

عَيْنُ جَالُوتَ.en: ʿAyn Jālūt — a spring and the place around it in the Jezreel valley of Palestine, near Baysān, where the Mamluks defeated the Mongols in Ramaḍān 658 / September 1260

عَيْن.en: a spring of water (the same word as «eye»)

بَأْس.en: might, valour in war (بَأْسًا after an elative: «in might»); also violent distress

بَيْبَرْس.en: Baybars — Rukn al-Dīn Baybars al-Bunduqdārī, Mamluk emir and later sultan (r. 658–676 / 1260–1277); a diptote (ʿalamiyya + ʿujma)

بَيْنَمَا.en: while — بَيْنَ with the extra مَا; in narrative its answer is opened by the إِذْ or إِذَا of surprise

حَلَب.en: Aleppo — the city of northern Syria (a diptote: a feminine proper name)

حَمَلَ.en: to carry; (with عَلَى) to charge an enemy

هَرَبَ.en: to flee, to run away (bāb naṣara: هَرَبَ يَهْرُبُ; intransitive)

هَزَمَ.en: to rout, to put to flight

إِذْ.en: when (a mabni zarf for past time — a noun, like عِنْد)

جَالُوتُ.en: Jālūt (Goliath) — the giant champion slain by Dāwūd; here in the place-name عَيْنُ جَالُوتَ «the Spring of Goliath»; a diptote (a foreign proper name)

كَمْ.en: how many? (interrogative; its khabari twin means «many a»)

خَمْسُونَ.en: fifty (declines like the sound masculine plural: خَمْسِينَ)

لَحِقَ.en: to catch up with, to join, to attach to

لَ (لَامُ الِابْتِدَاءِ).en: the lam of ibtida — emphasis, slid onto the khabar after inna

لَ (لَامُ الْقَسَمِ).en: the lam of the oath / its answer

مَمْلُوك.en: a mamlūk — literally «owned» (the passive participle of مَلَكَ): a slave-soldier; الْمَمَالِيك, the Mamluks who ruled Egypt and Syria

مَشْهُور.en: well-known, famous (the passive participle of شَهَرَ)

مُقَدِّمَة.en: the vanguard (of an army) — the part that marches in front; (of a book) the introduction

نَجَا.en: to be saved, to escape (نَجَا يَنْجُو)

قَبْلَ.en: before (a zarf of time or place)

قُطُز.en: Quṭuz — al-Malik al-Muẓaffar Sayf al-Dīn Quṭuz, Mamluk sultan of Egypt (r. 657–658 / 1259–1260), victor of ʿAyn Jālūt; written here as a diptote (a three-letter foreign name with a voweled middle)

رَاجِع.en: returning (ism fa'il of رَجَعَ; pl. رَاجِعُونَ)

سَارَ.en: to travel, to set out (a hollow verb, يَسِيرُ)

التَّتَار.en: the Tatars — the name the Arabic chronicles of the 7th/13th century give the Mongol armies

ثَبَتَ.en: to be established, to stand firm

يَوْمَئِذٍ.en: on that day (يَوْمَ annexed to إِذْ; the tanwin stands for a clause)

أَجْرَى.en: to make run, to make flow (Form IV, defective)

عَالَم.en: the world, all that exists besides God

دَهْرِيَّة.en: the Dahriyya — those who deny a Maker and ascribe all things to time (dahr)

حَكِيم.en: wise, the All-Wise (a name of Allah)

أَ (الِاسْتِفْهَام).en: the question hamza — what follows it is the thing asked about

جِدَال.en: disputation (a masdar of Form III جَادَلَ)

كَاذِب.en: lying, a liar (ism fāʿil of كَذَبَ)

كَيْفَ.en: how? (an interrogative NOUN, not a letter)

لَيْسَ.en: is not (conjugates in the past only)

مَالَ.en: to incline, to turn away (مَالَ يَمِيلُ — hollow)

مَلَّاح.en: a sailor, a seaman (فَعَّال of a trade)

مَنْقَبَة.en: a merit, a noble trait; (pl. مَنَاقِب) a book of a man's virtues and deeds

مَثَل.en: likeness; a state or condition (as in the Qur'anic مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ)

مُنَاظَرَة.en: a debate, a disputation (masdar of Form III نَاظَرَ)

نِ (نُونُ الْوِقَايَةِ).en: the nūn of protection before the speaker's yāʾ

صَدَّقَ.en: to affirm as true, to believe (Form II)

سُبْحَان.en: glory be to (used only as an object)

وَحْد.en: alone, by itself (always a hal: وَحْدَهُ)

زَعَمَ.en: to claim, to allege, to suppose (a verb of the heart)

عَادِل.en: just, fair (the active participle of عَدَلَ)

عَالٍ.en: high, elevated (the manqūṣ participle of عَلَا)

أَمَرَ.en: to command, to order (its amr is مُرْ)

ذُو.en: possessor of (one of the five nouns)

هٰكَذَا.en: thus, so (the kāf of likeness on the demonstrative)

لُغَة.en: language; the linguistic side of a thing

مَغْرِب.en: the west, the place of sunset

مَنْ.en: who, whoever — the relative and conditional noun (the mim's fatha tells it from مِنْ)

مَرَّة.en: a time, once; مَرَّةً … وَمَرَّةً: now … now

مَشْرِق.en: the east, the place of sunrise

نَقَبَ.en: to bore through, to tunnel (نَقَبَ يَنْقُبُ)

صَبَّ.en: to pour; صَبَّ عَلَيْهِ: to loose (a dog) upon (geminate)

تَرْجُمَان.en: interpreter; (here) one who repeats and makes plain

يَأْجُوج.en: Gog — of the peoples whose coming out is a sign of the Hour

اِخْتِلَاف.en: frequent coming and going (here); also: disagreement

تَهَاوَنَ.en: to make light of, belittle (بـ: someone)

مَا (الْمَصْدَرِيَّة).en: ma that turns its clause into a masdar

تَبَاعَدَ.en: to keep one's distance, move gradually away

عَجَزَ.en: to be unable, fall short (عَنْ: of)

لَا (النَّافِيَةُ لِلْجِنْس).en: no … at all (denies the whole genus)

أَعَادَ.en: to repeat, to do again (Form IV, hollow)

اللّٰهُمَّ.en: O God (the vocative with the mīm of compensation)

أَيْضًا.en: also, likewise (a masdar as maf'ul mutlaq)

فَتَنَ.en: to put to trial; to beguile, to seduce

فُلَان.en: so-and-so (stands in for any proper name)

ابْن.en: son; بَنُو = the sons of, a tribe

جُرَيْج.en: Jurayj — a worshipper of the Children of Israel (a name on the diminutive pattern فُعَيْل)

رَاعٍ.en: a shepherd (a manqus noun; pl. رُعَاة)

صَوْمَعَة.en: a hermit's cell, a hermitage (a monk's tower of worship)

وَلَدَ.en: to beget, to bear (وَلَدَ يَلِدُ — a mithal verb)

أَلْقَى.en: to deliver, to cast (a word) to someone

عَصًا.en: a staff, a stick (a maqsur noun)

بَنُونَ.en: sons, children (declines by letters, attached to the sound plural; بَنُو in idafa)

فَتَحَ.en: to open; to give a fatḥa

هَؤُلَاءِ.en: these (the plural demonstrative, built on kasra)

إِسْرَائِيل.en: Israel (Ya'qub); barred from tanwin for name and foreignness

مَدْيَن.en: Madyan — the town of Shuʿayb's people; a diptote

صَحْرَاء.en: a desert (a diptote, by the long feminine alif)

كَبِرَ.en: to grow up, grow big (كَبِرَ يَكْبَرُ)

عَدَا.en: «except» — exceptive: a jarr letter, or more often a verb

أَضَافَ.en: to annex, to put in idafa (Form IV, hollow)

أَفْصَح.en: the most eloquent (ism tafdil of فَصِيح)

أَلْ.en: «al» — the letter of definition (the article), here named as a word

الْعَامِل.en: the ʿāmil — the governor, what gives the word after it its case

أَمَّا.en: as for … (detailing; its answer takes فَ)

أَمْر.en: the imperative — the verb of command

أَعْرَبَ.en: to decline (a word), to give it iʿrāb; to express clearly

عَسَى.en: may it be that, perhaps — the frozen verb of hope (a sister of kāna)

بِئْسَ.en: how bad is… — the frozen verb of blame

ضَمَّة.en: the damma — the u-vowel sign, the sign of rafʿ

فَم.en: a mouth — annexed it becomes فُو / فِي / فَا (a five-noun)

فَتْحَة.en: the fatha — the a-vowel sign, the sign of nasb

غَزَا.en: to raid, to go on a campaign — a defective wāw-verb (yaghzū)

حَاجَّ.en: to dispute with, to argue against

حَم.en: a husband's kinsman, father-in-law (one of the six nouns)

هَن.en: «a thing» — a word for what one does not name (one of the six nouns)

هِنْد.en: Hind — the grammarians' stock woman's name

افْتِتَاح.en: the opening; حُرُوفُ الِافْتِتَاحِ: أَلَا، أَمَا — letters that open and alert

عِلِّيُّون.en: ʿIlliyyūn — the highest place; attached to the sound masculine plural

إِمَّا.en: either … or (a letter of detailing; it never comes alone)

انْصَرَفَ.en: to decline, to take tanwīn and kasra (form VII); munṣarif

إِنْشَاء.en: insha — speech that brings its meaning about (masdar, Form IV)

عِشْرُونَ.en: twenty — declined like the sound masculine plural (عِشْرُونَ / عِشْرِينَ)

إِسْنَاد.en: predication — leaning one term on another (masdar, Form IV)

اسْتَخْرَجَ.en: to extract, to bring out (form X)

جَرَّ.en: to drag; to put in the genitive (doubled; جَرَّ يَجُرُّ)

جَزَمَ.en: to put (a verb) in jazm; to cut off

كَسْرَة.en: the kasra — the i-vowel sign, the sign of jarr

كِلَا.en: both (annexed to a dual pronoun: كِلَاهُمَا)

مَبْنِيّ.en: built (ism maf'ul of بَنَى); in nahw: mabni, unchanging in its ending

الْمَاضِي.en: the past; the past-tense verb (ism fāʿil of مَضَى)

مَضْمُوم.en: carrying a ḍamma (ism mafʿūl of ضَمَّ)

مَفْتُوح.en: carrying a fatḥa (ism mafʿūl of فَتَحَ); الْمَفْتُوحَةُ: أَنَّ

الْمَحْذُوف.en: the omitted thing (ism mafʿūl of حَذَفَ)

مَكْسُور.en: carrying a kasra (ism mafʿūl of كَسَرَ); الْمَكْسُورَةُ: إِنَّ

مَقْصُور.en: confined, restricted to (ism mafʿūl of قَصَرَ)

مُؤَوَّل.en: the INTERPRETED — one face preferred by judgement

مُضَاف.en: the mudaf — the annexed head of an idafa (ism maf'ul of أَضَافَ)

الْمُضَارِع.en: the muḍāriʿ — the present-future verb, «the one that resembles» the noun

مُذَكَّر.en: masculine (ism maf'ul of Form II ذَكَّرَ)

مُضْمَر.en: concealed — a pronoun unspoken (ism mafʿūl of أَضْمَرَ)

مُفِيد.en: conveying, expressing — the Form IV ism fāʿil of أَفَادَ

مُخَاطَبَة.en: the feminine addressee — the second person singular feminine (ism mafʿūl of خَاطَبَ)

مُعْتَلّ.en: weak (of a radical: wāw, yāʾ or alif)

مُتَمَكِّن.en: fully declinable — the noun that takes the case endings (and tanwīn)

مُثَنًّى.en: the dual (ism maf'ul of Form II ثَنَّى; a maqsur)

مُطْلَقًا.en: absolutely, without restriction (ism mafʿūl of أَطْلَقَ as a ḥāl)

نَقْص.en: shortening — dropping the last letter (of the six nouns)

نَصَبَ.en: to set up; to put in the accusative (نَصَبَ يَنْصُبُ)

نَأَيْتَ.en: the mnemonic for the four letters of the muḍāriʿ: ن أ ي ت

نِعْمَ.en: «how excellent is …» — the frozen verb of praise

نُون.en: the letter nūn; the nūn (of the dual, of the sound plural)

قَعَدَ.en: to sit back, hold back (with عن)

قَدَّرَ.en: to estimate, to assume an unspoken wording

رَفْع.en: lifting, removing (masdar) — also the name of the raf' case

رُبَاعِيّ.en: four-lettered (of a verb's māḍī) — bare دَحْرَجَ or augmented أَفْعَلَ، فَعَّلَ، فَاعَلَ

سَبْعَة.en: seven (with the ta before a masculine counted noun)

سَالِم.en: sound, whole (ism fa'il of سَلِمَ) — جَمْعٌ سَالِم: the sound plural

سُكُون.en: the sukun — the absence of a vowel; stillness (masdar of سَكَنَ)

تَاء.en: the letter tāʾ — named as a noun; here the tāʾ of the oath (تَاللهِ)

تَعَالَ.en: come! — a fixed imperative used only in this form

تَأْنِيث.en: making feminine — the feminine sign on the governor (maṣdar of أَنَّثَ)

ثِنْتَانِ.en: two (feminine) — a variant of اِثْنَتَانِ; attached to the dual

أُولَات.en: «possessors of» (feminine) — attached to the plural in alif and tāʾ; always annexed

أُولُو.en: «possessors of» — the plural of ذُو by usage, declined like the sound masculine plural (أُولُو / أُولِي)

وِقَايَة.en: protection — نُونُ الْوِقَايَةِ: the nūn that guards the verb's ending from the kasra before the speaker's yāʾ

يَاء.en: the letter ya — يَاءُ الْمُتَكَلِّمِ: the speaker's ya

يُفْعِلُ.en: the pattern يُفْعِلُ — the muḍāriʿ of Form IV, its prefix on a ḍamma

ظَاهِر.en: manifest, out in the open (ism fa'il)

نُوح.en: Nūḥ (Noah) — a three-letter foreign name with a quiet middle: it declines in full

تَفْصِيل.en: detailing, one by one (masdar of فَصَّلَ)

تَطْوِيل.en: lengthening, going at length (masdar of طَوَّلَ)

حَلَّ.en: to settle, to alight (حَلَّ مَحَلَّ: to take the place of)

وَعَى.en: to retain, to take in and keep (of memory)

رَدَّدَ.en: to repeat, to recite over (Form II)

غَرَابَة.en: strangeness — a word too far out of use to be understood

صِرَاع.en: a struggle, a conflict (masdar of صَارَعَ)

يَقِين.en: certainty — knowledge with no doubt in it

ظَنّ.en: a thought, a supposition (masdar of ظَنَّ; pl. ظُنُون)

عِبْرَة.en: a lesson, an example to take to heart

الْأَيْكَة.en: the Thicket — أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ, Shuʿayb's people

طَفَّفَ.en: to skimp in measuring, to give short measure (Form II)

تَعَرَّضَ.en: to waylay, to set upon (تَعَرَّضَ لِ) (Form V)

أَخَافَ.en: to frighten, to terrify (Form IV, hollow)

عَاثَ.en: to wreak havoc (عَاثَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا)

أَوْفَى.en: to give in full, to fulfil (Form IV)

بَخَسَ.en: to deprive, to give less than due (two objects)

بَسَطَ.en: to spread out; بَسَطَ فِي الْكَلَامِ: to speak at length

أَثْرَى.en: to grow rich (Form IV naqis; أَثْرَى يُثْرِي)

اِكْتَسَبَ.en: to earn for oneself, incur (Form VIII)

مَصِير.en: the end, the fate, where something ends up

سَلَّطَ.en: to set (someone) over, to give power over (Form II)

بَقِيَّة.en: what remains, the remainder; بَقِيَّتُ اللهِ: what God leaves you

حَفِيظ.en: a keeper, a guardian (ṣifa mushabbaha on فَعِيل)

تَنَوَّعَ.en: to vary, to be of many kinds (Form V)

خِطَاب.en: address, speech (masdar of Form III خَاطَبَ) — فَصْلُ الْخِطَابِ: the decisive word, أَمَّا بَعْدُ

تَفَنَّنَ.en: to use every art, to vary one's ways (Form V)

ذَلِكُمْ.en: that (the far demonstrative, addressed to a plural)

دَقَّقَ.en: to scrutinise, to examine minutely (Form II)

تَعْلِيل.en: giving the cause, purpose (the lam of taʿlil)

مُنَادًى.en: the munādā, the one called (passive participle of nādā)

كَمِّيَّة.en: quantity, how-many-ness (the abstract noun of كَمْ)

تَصْيِير.en: making (one thing into another) — the sense in which ثَالِثٌ «makes two three» (masdar of Form II صَيَّرَ)

تَكْسِير.en: breaking — جَمْعُ التَّكْسِيرِ: the broken plural (masdar of Form II كَسَّرَ)

حَمْرَاء.en: red (feminine of أَحْمَر) — on the lengthened alif

حُبْلَى.en: pregnant — on the shortened alif of the feminine

قَلَبَ.en: to turn (a letter) into another, to invert (قَلَبَ يَقْلِبُ)

قُرَّاء.en: reciters (a plural of قَارِئ) — a mamdūd whose hamza is the root's own

كِسَاء.en: a cloak, a garment — a mamdūd whose hamza stands for a radical wāw

خُصْيَة.en: a testicle — dual خُصْيَانِ without the tāʾ, against the rule

أَلْيَة.en: the fat of a sheep's tail — dual أَلْيَانِ without the tāʾ, against the rule

هَمْزَة.en: the hamza (glottal stop); hamzat al-waṣl, the joining hamza that drops in connected speech

مَا (الصِّفَة).en: the vague مَا used as an adjective: تَغَيُّرٌ مَا «some change», يَوْمًا مَا «some day»

تَمْر.en: dates (a generic noun, not a plural: one is تَمْرَة)

أَصَحّ.en: sounder, more correct (the elative of صَحِيح)

فَعْلَاء.en: the pattern فَعْلَاءُ — the feminine of أَفْعَلُ in colours and defects (حَمْرَاءُ)

فَعْلَان.en: the pattern فَعْلَانُ — whose feminine is فَعْلَى (سَكْرَانُ سَكْرَى)

فَعْلَى.en: the pattern فَعْلَى — the feminine of فَعْلَانُ (سَكْرَى)

سَكْرَان.en: drunk — with the added alif and nūn; feminine sakrā (diptote)

جَرِيح.en: wounded — one form for both genders (رَجُلٌ جَرِيحٌ، امْرَأَةٌ جَرِيحٌ)

صَبُور.en: very patient — one form for both genders

عَلَّامَة.en: a great scholar — an intensive on فَعَّالَة whose tāʾ bars the wāw-plural

شَاذّ.en: against the rule, irregular (heard but not analogical)

مَنْصُور.en: helped, given victory (ism maf'ul of نَصَرَ)

حَائِض.en: menstruating (a description with no masculine; plural حُيَّضٌ, and حَائِضَاتٌ only from حَائِضَة)

مُجَرَّد.en: bared, drawn; stripped of (ism maf'ul of Form II جَرَّدَ)

فُلْك.en: ship(s) — one form for singular and plural

مُصْطَفًى.en: chosen, elect (passive participle of iṣṭafā, form VIII); plural muṣṭafawna

رَكْب.en: a caravan of riders (a collective; pl. رُكُوب)

أَفْعُل.en: the pattern أَفْعُلٌ — a plural of paucity (فُلْس → أَفْلُس)

أَفْعِلَة.en: the pattern أَفْعِلَةٌ — a plural of paucity (رَغِيف → أَرْغِفَة)

فِعْلَة.en: the pattern فِعْلَةٌ — a plural of paucity (غُلَام → غِلْمَة)

فَعَالِل.en: the pattern faʿālil — the plural of plurals, a diptote (masājid)

غَفِير.en: many, a throng (الْجَمُّ الْغَفِيرُ); plural غُفْرَان

قَاضِيَة.en: a female judge; the notebook gives قُضَاة as its plural

مُقَيَّد.en: the RESTRICTED — takes in what carries an added description

مُنْتَهًى.en: limit, utmost point (Form VIII derived noun of اِنْتَهَى)

صَائِم.en: fasting (ism fa'il of a hollow verb)

جَلْسَة.en: one sitting — the maṣdar of number (مَصْدَرُ الْمَرَّةِ) on فَعْلَة

جِلْسَة.en: a manner of sitting — the maṣdar of kind (مَصْدَرُ الْهَيْئَةِ) on فِعْلَة

اِسْتِخْرَاج.en: extraction — the maṣdar of اِسْتَخْرَجَ on اِسْتِفْعَال

جَلَّاد.en: an executioner, a flogger — an intensive on فَعَّال

أَضْمَرَ.en: to hide in the mind, keep unspoken (Form IV)

إِخْرَاج.en: putting out, sending forth (masdar, Form IV)

إِعْمَال.en: making govern, letting a governor act (masdar of أَعْمَلَ)

مُعَرَّف.en: made definite (ism mafʿūl of عَرَّفَ); مُعَرَّفٌ بِاللَّامِ

سَمَاعِيّ.en: heard — known only by transmission, not by rule (nisba)

سَقْي.en: watering, giving to drink — سَقْيًا «water to you!» (the maṣdar in its verb's place)

حُدُوث.en: occurrence, coming-to-be — the transient sense that separates the ism fāʿil from the ṣifa mushabbaha

مُخْرِج.en: one who brings out — the ism fāʿil of Form IV أَخْرَجَ

مُسْتَخْرِج.en: one who extracts — the ism fāʿil of Form X اِسْتَخْرَجَ

مُسْتَخْرَج.en: extracted — the ism mafʿūl of Form X اِسْتَخْرَجَ, one fatḥa from مُسْتَخْرِج

الْكِسَائِيّ.en: al-Kisāʾī (d. 189/805), the Kufan grammarian and reader

مُعْطِي.en: a giver — the manqūṣ ism fāʿil of أَعْطَى

مُعْطًى.en: given — the maqṣūr ism mafʿūl of أَعْطَى (الْمُعْطَى with the article)

ضَرَّاب.en: a hard hitter — the intensive on فَعَّال

ضَرُوب.en: a hard hitter — the intensive on فَعُول

مِضْرَاب.en: a hard hitter — the intensive on مِفْعَال

غُفُل.en: very heedless — the intensive on فُعُل

الِاسْتِقْبَال.en: the future, the time to come (masdar of اسْتَقْبَلَ)

الْمَفْعُول.en: the mafʿūl — the object (ism mafʿūl of فَعَلَ); الْمَفْعُولُ فِيهِ، الْمَفْعُولُ لَهُ

شَكْس.en: ill-tempered, contrary — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فَعْل

خَشِن.en: rough, coarse — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فَعِل

عَجُل.en: hasty — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فَعُل

شَيْظَم.en: tall and sturdy (of a horse or man) — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فَيْعَل

أَبْلَج.en: bright-browed, clear — a ṣifa mushabbaha on أَفْعَل, a diptote

قُبْح.en: ugliness — of a construction the grammarians tolerate but dislike

اِمْتَنَعَ.en: to be impossible; to refuse (Form VIII)

مُشَبَّهَة.en: resembling, likened — الصِّفَةُ الْمُشَبَّهَةُ, the adjective likened to the ism fāʿil

اِرْتِبَاط.en: a tie, connection — the maṣdar of اِرْتَبَطَ

مُتَعَدٍّ.en: transitive — a verb whose sense needs an object (ism fāʿil of تَعَدَّى, a manqūṣ)

نَائِب.en: a deputy — نَائِبُ الْفَاعِلِ: the deputy doer of a passive

نَصَبَ.en: to put in naṣb — the grammarians' نَصَبَ يَنْصِبُ (bāb ضَرَبَ)

فُعْلَى.en: the pattern فُعْلَى — the feminine of the ism tafḍīl (كُبْرَى، فُضْلَى)

أَخْيَر.en: better — the full form behind خَيْر the elative

أَشَرّ.en: worse — the full form behind شَرّ the elative

أَعْذَر.en: more excused — an elative in the sense of the object

أَلْوَم.en: more blamed — an elative in the sense of the object

أَشْغَل.en: more occupied — an elative in the sense of the object

فُضْلَى.en: the most excellent (feminine) — the فُعْلَى of أَفْضَل

مُؤَخَّر.en: delayed, placed later (of a mubtada or khabar)

حَسُنَ.en: to be good, to be fitting

مُسَبَّب.en: effect, what is caused (ism maf'ul of سَبَّبَ)

مُطَابَقَة.en: conforming, fitting one another (masdar, Form III)

السِّين.en: the letter sīn — named as a noun; here the prefix of the near future

تَقْلِيل.en: making few; the sense of fewness (masdar of قَلَّلَ)

يُفَعِّلُ.en: the pattern يُفَعِّلُ — the muḍāriʿ of Form II, its prefix on a ḍamma

يُفَاعِلُ.en: the pattern يُفَاعِلُ — the muḍāriʿ of Form III, its prefix on a ḍamma

يَسْتَفْعِلُ.en: the pattern يَسْتَفْعِلُ — the muḍāriʿ of Form X, its prefix on a fatḥa

جَازِم.en: a jāzim — a governor that puts the muḍāriʿ in jazm (ism fāʿil of جَزَمَ)

مُضَارَعَة.en: resemblance — حَرْفُ الْمُضَارَعَةِ: the prefix letter of the muḍāriʿ (أ ن ي ت)

مُشْتَرَك.en: the SHARED — set down for differing meanings

مُتَحَرِّك.en: vowelled, bearing a vowel (of a letter)

تْ (تَاءُ التَّأْنِيثِ).en: the ta of femininity (on a verb)

تَأْبِيد.en: perpetuity — «for ever», which لَنْ does not assert

السَّبَبِيَّة.en: the sense of cause — what follows is the reason or purpose: كَيْ, فَاءُ السَّبَبِيَّةِ

تَمَنٍّ (التَّمَنِّي).en: the wish, longing for what is unlikely (masdar of تَمَنَّى) — the meaning of لَيْتَ

جَمْعِيَّة.en: joining — the wāw of accompaniment's sense: both things together

أَلَا (التَّنْبِيه).en: the alerting ala — precedes إِنَّ, wakes the hearer, governs nothing

بَرِحَ.en: to leave a place — مَا بَرِحَ: did not cease, a sister of kāna

ابْتِدَاء.en: a beginning, an opening (masdar of ابْتَدَأَ)

اِعْتَمَدَ.en: to lean on, to depend on (Form VIII)

كَيْ.en: «so that» — a nāṣib of the muḍāriʿ; before the interrogative مَا, a jarr letter of cause

مَعْطُوف.en: the word joined (maʿṭūf) — what follows the conjunction

نَاصِب.en: a nāṣib — a governor that puts the muḍāriʿ in naṣb (ism fāʿil of نَصَبَ)

الْمُجَازَاة.en: requital — condition and its answer (masdar of جَازَى); كَلِمُ الْمُجَازَاةِ the conditional words

اِسْتِغْرَاق.en: exhaustion of a span — the sense that makes لَمَّا narrower than لَمْ

إِفَادَة.en: conveying, giving a meaning — the maṣdar of أَفَادَ

الِاسْمِيَّة.en: noun-hood — being a noun (the nisba abstract)

سَكَّنَ.en: to make quiescent, to put a sukūn on (Form II)

نَاهِيَة.en: prohibiting — the لَا that asks for an act to be left

أَخَصّ.en: more specific (ism tafdil of the doubled خَصَّ)

خُمَاسِيّ.en: five-lettered (of a verb's māḍī) — اِفْتَعَلَ، اِنْفَعَلَ، تَفَعَّلَ، تَفَاعَلَ

مَبْدُوء.en: begun, opened (with a letter) — the ism mafʿūl of بَدَأَ

إِشْمَام.en: ishmām — leaning the kasra of قِيلَ toward a ḍamma (and the yāʾ toward a wāw), a Qurʾānic reading

اِنْفِعَال.en: the pattern اِنْفِعَال — the maṣdar and name of Form VII

إِفْعَال.en: the pattern إِفْعَال — the maṣdar and name of Form IV

اِفْتِعَال.en: concocting, fabricating (the Form VIII masdar as a common noun)

اِقْتَدَرَ.en: to be able, to have power over

خَبَّرَ.en: to tell, to inform (Form II) — transitive to three objects in the sense of أَعْلَمَ

تَعَدَّى.en: to pass over to, to be transitive to (Form V)

اِتِّهَام.en: suspicion, accusing — the one-object sense of ظَنَّ

أَعْلَمَ.en: to inform, to let know (three objects)

إِلْغَاء.en: nullifying — stripping a governor of its work (masdar of أَلْغَى)

خَالَ.en: to think, to suppose (خَالَ يَخَالُ; إِخَالُ «I think» with its kasra'd hamza)

مُنْطَلِق.en: setting out, departing (ism fail of اِنْطَلَقَ)

مُتَعَلَّق.en: what a thing hangs on, its object of relation (ism mafʿul of تَعَلَّقَ)

كَائِنَة.en: what comes to pass, an event — the feminine ism fāʿil of the complete كَانَ

اِسْتِمْرَار.en: continuance — the sense of مَا زَالَ and her sisters

تَوْقِيت.en: fixing a span — the sense of مَا دَامَ

آضَ.en: to become — a sister of kāna (hollow, hamza-initial: آضَ يَئِيضُ أَيْضًا)

أَضْحَى.en: to become (in the forenoon) — a sister of kāna

فَتِئَ.en: to cease — مَا فَتِئَ: did not cease (also فَتَأَ), a sister of kāna

غَدَا.en: to become (in the morning), to go early — a sister of kāna

اِنْفَكَّ.en: to come apart — مَا انْفَكَّ: did not cease (Form VII, doubled), a sister of kāna

مَانِع.en: a preventer, what bars (active participle of manaʿa)

مُنْقَطِع.en: disjoined — an exception not drawn from the whole (ism fāʿil of انْقَطَعَ)

رَاحَ.en: to become (in the evening), to go — a sister of kāna (hollow)

تَقْرِير.en: tacit approval — his silence at an act (masdar, Form II)

دُنُوّ.en: nearness, drawing near — the maṣdar of دَنَا

مُحِبّ.en: a lover — the Form IV ism fāʿil of أَحَبَّ; plural مُحِبُّونَ

رَسِيس.en: the residue, the first trace (of a passion)

مَيَّة.en: Mayya — the beloved of Dhū l-Rumma's poems

ابْن شُبْرُمَة.en: Ibn Shubruma (d. 144/761) — the Kufan judge and man of letters who corrected Dhū l-Rumma

اِعْتَرَضَ.en: to object, to raise an objection (Form VIII)

خَصَفَ.en: to stitch together, to patch (leaves, sandals)

أَبْدَلَ.en: to substitute, to make a badal (form IV)

أَوْشَكَ.en: to be on the verge of (a verb of approach, used like ʿasā and kāda)

ذُو الرُّمَّة.en: Dhu l-Rumma — Ghaylan b. ʿUqba, the Umayyad desert poet (d. 117/735)

هَوًى.en: passion, love; the desire of the soul (maqsur; pl. أَهْوَاء)

كَرَبَ.en: to be on the point of (a verb of approach, like kāda)

مُقَارَبَة.en: approach, nearness (masdar of قَارَبَ); أَفْعَالُ الْمُقَارَبَةِ

مُتَصَرِّف.en: conjugable — a verb with changing forms, unlike the frozen عَسَى / لَيْسَ

طَفِقَ.en: to begin to (a verb of beginning)

تَعَجُّب.en: wonder, astonishment — the maṣdar of تَعَجَّبَ; the verb of wonder expresses it

الْمَازِنِيّ.en: Abū ʿUthmān al-Māzinī (d. 249/863) — the Basran grammarian, teacher of al-Mubarrad

الْبَاء.en: the letter ba — named as a word

تَصَرَّفَ.en: to act freely on, to work upon (Form V; تَصَرَّفَ فِيهِ)

مَاهِد.en: one who spreads out, who smooths a bed — the ism fāʿil of مَهَدَ; plural مَاهِدُونَ

مَا (النَّكِرَةُ التَّامَّةُ).en: mā as a complete indefinite meaning «a thing» — the tamyīz of niʿma's hidden doer in نِعِمَّا

حَبَّذَا.en: how lovely is… — حَبَّ with its frozen doer ذَا, a verb of praise

مَخْصُوص.en: proper to, singled out (ism maf'ul of خَصَّ)

مُمَيَّز.en: explained by a tamyīz (ism mafʿūl of مَيَّزَ)

سَاءَ.en: to be bad, to turn foul (hollow; سَاءَ يَسُوءُ)

إِفْضَاء.en: carrying over, conveying — the maṣdar of أَفْضَى; a jarr letter carries the verb's reach over to its noun

تَبْيِين.en: explanation — min stating what a vague word meant (the relative test)

مُوجَب.en: affirmative (of speech) — the ism mafʿūl of أَوْجَبَ; its opposite holds a negation, a prohibition or a question

خَلَا.en: «except» — an exceptive letter, counted among the jarr letters (خَلَا زَيْدٍ); after مَا it is a verb governing naṣb

مُصَنِّف.en: an author, the compiler of a book (ism fa'il of صَنَّفَ)

مُشَبَّه.en: the mushabbah — what is likened (ism maf'ul of شَبَّهَ)

أَتَمَّ.en: to complete, to bring to its end (Form IV, doubled)

ظَرْفِيَّة.en: containment — the sense of fī, a place or time holding what is in it

الْمُبَرِّد.en: Al-Mubarrad (d. 285/898) — the Basran grammarian, author of al-Muqtaḍab

ذَاهِب.en: departing, going away (ism fa'il of ذَهَبَ)

إِلْصَاق.en: attachment — the bāʾ's meaning (masdar of أَلْصَقَ)

اِنْتِهَاء.en: coming to an end (masdar, Form VIII)

اسْتِعَانَة.en: istiʿana — seeking aid (masdar of Form X اسْتَعَانَ); of the tadmin: a whole bayt or more woven in

مَطْلَع.en: a rising-place; the opening bayt of a poem (pl. مَطَالِع)

مُخْتَصّ.en: proper to, peculiar to (ism faʿil of اِخْتَصَّ)

مُصَاحَبَة.en: accompaniment — the maṣdar of form III «to accompany»

رَدِفَ.en: to come close behind, to follow at the back (27:72)

كَافَّة.en: the مَا that «stops» a governor from governing — مَا الْكَافَّة

الْبِرْكِوِيّ.en: Al-Birgivī (Birgivî Mehmed Efendi, d. 981/1573) — author of the ʿAwāmil and the Iẓhār

بَلْدَة.en: a town, a tract of land

أَنِيس.en: a companion, one who keeps one company

يَعْفُور.en: a wild ass (or a gazelle fawn); plural يَعَافِير

عِيس.en: white camels tinged with red (a collective)

اِخْتِصَاص.en: being proper to, exclusiveness (masdar of اخْتَصَّ)

تَكْثِير.en: making many, multiplying — kam of statement means takthīr

وَ (الْقَسَم).en: the wāw of the oath — a jarr letter on an explicit noun with the verb of swearing dropped: وَاللهِ

بِ (الْقَسَم).en: the bāʾ of the oath — the most general oath letter: with or without the verb, on noun or pronoun

نَّ (نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ).en: the heavy nūn of emphasis on the verb of an oath's answer

دُون.en: without, short of; below (a ẓarf, always annexed)

أَعَمّ.en: more general (ism tafdil of عَامّ; diptote)

مُنْهَمّ.en: melting, running (of hail) — the Form VII ism fāʿil of انْهَمَّ

تَجَاوُز.en: passing beyond — the maṣdar of تَجَاوَزَ

نَ (نُونُ النِّسْوَةِ).en: the nūn of the women — the feminine-plural subject pronoun that builds the verb on sukūn

اِسْتِعْلَاء.en: counting oneself above the one addressed (masdar, Form X)

لِهْزِمَة.en: the jaw-corner, the jowl; plural لَهَازِم — the «slave of the nape and the jowls» is a glutton

فَاء.en: the letter fāʾ — named as a noun; فَاءُ الْجَزَاءِ

اسْتِدْرَاك.en: istidrak — the retraction of لَكِنَّ and its sisters (masdar of اسْتَدْرَكَ)

مِفْتَح.en: a key (also مِفْتَاح); the plural مَفَاتِح is a diptote

نَاءَ.en: to weigh down, to make stagger under a load (نَاءَ بِهِ)

ضُحَكَة.en: one who laughs much at people — on فُعَلَة, for the doer

ضُحْكَة.en: one much laughed at, a laughing-stock — on فُعْلَة, for the object

دُئِل.en: a small weasel-like animal, and the name of a tribe — a rare word on the measure فُعِل

فَعَال.en: the measure faʿāl — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (جَبَان)

وَزْنُ فَاعَلٍ.en: the measure fāʿal — what analogy would give for the doer's noun from يَفْعَلُ

وَزْنُ فَعَلٍ.en: the measure faʿal — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (حَسَن)

فَعِل.en: the measure faʿil — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (فَرِق)

فَعْل.en: the measure faʿl — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (شَكْس)

وَزْنُ فَعْلٍ.en: the measure faʿl — as in مَدّ, whose first dāl is quiescent and so must be merged

وَزْنُ فَعْلَةٍ.en: the measure faʿla — the noun of the single time (ism al-marra)

فَرِق.en: fearful, easily frightened — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فَعِل (from فَرِقَ, to fear)

فَرُوقَة.en: very fearful — فَعُولَة, with the tāʾ of intensity

فَاصِل.en: separating, dividing — الْأَلِفُ الْفَاصِلَةُ: the alif that parts the nūns (ism fāʿil of فَصَلَ)

وَزْنُ فَاعُلٍ.en: the measure fāʿul — what analogy would give for the doer's noun from يَفْعُلُ

وَزْنُ فَوْعَلٍ.en: the measure fawʿal — as in جَوْرَب

فَوَات.en: passing away, being missed — the lack of a thing (maṣdar of فَاتَ)

وَزْنُ فَوْعِلٍ.en: the measure fawʿil — not found in the Arabs' speech

فِعْل.en: the measure fiʿl — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (مِلْح)

وَزْنُ فِعْلَةٍ.en: the measure fiʿla — the noun of manner (ism al-hayʾa)

فِرَار.en: a fleeing, an escape (maṣdar of فَرَّ)

فِسِّيق.en: utterly dissolute, ever sinning — an intensive on فِعِّيل

فِعُل.en: the measure «فِعُل» — a kasra followed by a ḍamma, which the language avoids

فُعَال.en: the measure fuʿāl — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (شُجَاع)

فُعْل.en: the measure fuʿl — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (صُلْب)

فُعْلَل.en: the measure fuʿlal — a pattern on which, the author says, no word comes

فُعُل.en: the measure fuʿul — one of the measures of the ṣifa mushabbaha (جُنُب)

غَلَبَة.en: prevailing, victory — a maṣdar of غَلَبَ

غَيْبُوبَة.en: absence, being hidden (a maṣdar of غَابَ on the measure فَيْعُولَة)

غُيَبَة.en: one who is much absent — an intensive of غَائِب on the measure فُعَلَة

هَبَنَّقَة.en: Habannaqa — a man of the Arabs proverbial for his foolishness (أَحْمَقُ مِنْ هَبَنَّقَةَ); a diptote

حَبَّ.en: to become beloved — one of the few doubled verbs on فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ (حَبُبْتُ)

حَائِك.en: a weaver (plural حَوَكَة — kept sound, on the measure فَعَلَة)

حَلُوبَة.en: a milch animal, one that is milked — فَعُولَة in the sense of مَفْعُولَة

حَمُقَ.en: to be foolish (حَمُقَ يَحْمُقُ; حَمِقَ is a dialect form)

حَوْأَبَة.en: a wide, capacious thing — a broad bucket (a broad valley is حَوْأَب) — lightened: حَوَبَةٌ

هَوِيَ.en: to love, to be fond of

حَوْقَلَ.en: to grow old and feeble — attached to دَحْرَجَ by a wāw

حَيَدَى.en: a donkey that shies from its own shadow — a feminine measure kept sound

هَيْعُوعَة.en: retching, vomiting (a maṣdar of هَاعَ يَهُوعُ; wāw-rooted, on the measure فَيْعُولَة)

حَيَّا.en: to greet; (of God) to give life, to keep alive

حِبُك.en: «ḥibuk» — a rare reading of حُبُك (the paths of the sky), cited for the measure فِعُل

حِثِّيثَى.en: much urging — the intensive maṣdar of حَثَّ

هُدَابِد.en: the full form of هُدَبِد (thick milk) before its alif was shortened

هُدَبِد.en: thick, curdled milk; dimness of sight — the stock example of four vowels in a row, shortened from هُدَابِد

صضطظ خغق.en: the seven elevated letters: the four covered ones ص ض ط ظ, then خ غ ق

تدذز سصضطظ.en: the nine letters into which the tāʾ of iftiʿāl may be merged when they stand after it: ت د ذ ز س ص ض ط ظ

اتثدذز سشص ضطظوي.en: the fourteen letters that may be merged when they stand before the tāʾ of iftiʿāl: ا ت ث د ذ ز س ش ص ض ط ظ و ي

الْحُسَيْن.en: al-Ḥusayn — son of ʿAlī and grandson of the Prophet, killed at Karbalāʾ (61/680)

اِبْتَسَمَ.en: to smile (iftaʿala of بَسَمَ — also يَبَسِّمُ, the tāʾ merged into the sīn)

عِدَة.en: a promise — the maṣdar of وَعَدَ with its wāw dropped

عِدَاد.en: number, count — «مِنْ عِدَادِ الْأَسْمَاءِ»: reckoned among the nouns

اِدَّانَ.en: to take a debt, to buy on credit (iftaʿala of دَانَ; its origin is اِدْتَيَنَ)

إِدْرَاج.en: inserting, folding one thing into another (masdar of أَدْرَجَ)

إِيلَاج.en: making enter, inserting (masdar of أَوْلَجَ — the wāw turned into a yāʾ after the kasra)

اِجْتَلَبَ.en: to bring in, to fetch (Form VIII)

اِجْتَوَرَ.en: «اِجْتَوَرَ» — they were neighbours to one another; a Form VIII verb kept sound because it has the sense of «تَجَاوَرَ»

اِخْتَصَمَ.en: to dispute with one another (iftaʿala of خَصَمَ — also خِصَّمَ / اِخِصَّمَ, the tāʾ merged into the ṣād)

اِكْتَفَى.en: to be content with, to make do with (bi: with) (Form VIII, defective)

اِكْتِفَاء.en: being content with, letting something suffice (masdar, Form VIII)

إِلْبَاث.en: making a thing stay, holding it in its place (masdar of أَلْبَثَ)

إِلْحَاقِيّ.en: a word of ilḥāq — one made to follow a longer measure by an added letter, so that its two like letters are not merged

انْعِدَام.en: absence, non-existence — the maṣdar of انْعَدَمَ

اِنْتَضَلَ.en: to compete in shooting arrows (iftaʿala of نَضَلَ — also يَنَضِّلُ)

اِنْتَظَمَ.en: to be strung together, to fall into order (iftaʿala of نَظَمَ — also يَنَظِّمُ)

إِرَاءَة.en: showing, causing to see (masdar of أَرَى)

إِشْبَاع.en: lengthening a vowel until its letter is heard (أَلِفُ الْإِشْبَاعِ: the alif born of a lengthened fatḥa)

اِشْتَبَهَ.en: to be alike, to be hard to tell apart (iftaʿala of شَبِهَ — also اِشَّبَهَ, the tāʾ made a shīn and merged)

اِشْتِرَاك.en: sharing, holding one thing in common (masdar of اِشْتَرَكَ)

إِسْكَان.en: giving a sukūn, making the last letter vowelless (the maṣdar of askana)

اِصْطَبَرَ.en: to hold oneself in patience (iftaʿala of صَبَرَ; its origin is اِصْتَبَرَ — also اِصَّبَرَ)

اِسْتَدَانَ.en: to seek a loan, to borrow (istafʿala of دَانَ; its origin is اِسْتَدْيَنَ)

اِسْتَحْوَذَ.en: «اِسْتَحْوَذَ» — he gained mastery over; the Form X verb kept sound against its bāb

اِسْتَطْعَمَ.en: to ask for food (istafʿala of طَعِمَ)

اِسْتِدْعَاء.en: calling for, the pull a thing has on another (masdar of اِسْتَدْعَى)

اِسْتِعْلَائِيَّة.en: being elevated — the quality the elevated letters share

اسْتِتَار.en: hiding, concealment (maṣdar of اسْتَتَرَ) — وَاجِبُ الِاسْتِتَارِ، جَائِزُ الِاسْتِتَارِ

اِيتَكَلَ.en: to flare up, to burn with anger (iftaʿala of أَكَلَ; its origin is اِئْتَكَلَ — the hamza turned into a yāʾ after the kasra)

اِثَّأَرَ.en: to take one's blood-revenge (iftaʿala of ثَأَرَ; its origin is اِثْتَأَرَ — the matn cites it with the hamza lightened: اِثَّارَ، اِتَّارَ)

اِتَّجَرَ.en: to trade (iftaʿala of تَجَرَ; its origin is اِتْتَجَرَ)

اِطَّلَبَ.en: to seek out, to go after (iftaʿala of طَلَبَ; its origin is اِطْتَلَبَ)

اِتَّقَدَ.en: to catch fire, to blaze (iftaʿala of وَقَدَ; its origin is اِوْتَقَدَ)

اِعْوَرَّ.en: «اِعْوَرَّ» — he became one-eyed; the Form IX verb, whose ʿayn is quiescent

اِزْدَانَ.en: to be adorned (iftaʿala of زَانَ; its origin is اِزْتَيَنَ — also اِزَّانَ)

جَبَذَ.en: to pull, to draw — a variant of جَذَبَ

جَدْوَل.en: a brook, a small stream — a noun attached (mulḥaq) to the four-letter measure فَعْلَل

جَهْوَرَ.en: to raise the voice — attached to دَحْرَجَ by a wāw

جَلْبَبَ.en: to clothe someone in a jilbāb — made to follow دَحْرَجَ by doubling its bāʾ

الْجَارّ.en: the governing letter, «the jārr» (ism fāʿil of جَرَّ) — paired with its majrūr

جَوْرَب.en: a sock, a stocking — a word on the measure فَوْعَل

جِنِّي.en: Ibn Jinnī — Abū al-Fatḥ ʿUthmān, the grammarian of Mosul (d. 392 AH)

جِنْسِيَّة.en: being of one kind — the sameness of two letters

جُدّ.en: a well in a place of plentiful pasture; a shore

جُوَنٌ.en: the matn's example of a hamza with fatḥa after a ḍamma turned into a wāw: جُوَنٌ, from جُؤَنٌ (plural of جُؤْنَة, a perfumer's case)

خَائِن.en: a traitor, one who betrays (plural خَوَنَة — kept sound, on the measure فَعَلَة)

خَرَّجَ.en: to work out, to derive (a ruling or a question from its rule) (Form II)

خَرُقَ.en: to be clumsy, not to do a thing well (خَرُقَ يَخْرُقُ; خَرِقَ is a dialect form)

خَسَاسَة.en: lowliness, meanness — being too low to be named

خَيْشُوم.en: the nasal passage, the upper part of the nose

خُلُوّ.en: being empty of, being free of (masdar of خَلَا)

كِلَّام.en: speaking to — a maṣdar of كَلَّمَ on فِعَّال

كُبَّار.en: very great, huge — an intensive on فُعَّال

كُدْرَة.en: turbidity, dinginess — a maṣdar of كَدِرَ

لَبَّ.en: to become intelligent, of sound understanding — one of the few doubled verbs on فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ; its present is cited as the printing vowels it

لَبْس.en: confusion, one thing being taken for another

لَاهٌ.en: the matn's steps toward the Name: «إِلَاهٌ» with its hamza dropped is لَاهٌ; with the alif and the lām, الْلَاهُ (or, on the other account, اَلِلَاهُ) — before the two lāms merge

لَقِيطَة.en: a foundling girl — فَعِيلَة in the sense of مَفْعُولَة, used as a noun

لَؤُمَ.en: to be base, mean (فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ; its hamza is its ʿayn)

لَيَّان.en: putting off (a debt), delaying — a maṣdar of لَوَى

لَيَّنَ.en: to soften — to lighten the hamza toward a weak letter (Form II of لَانَ)

لُؤْم.en: baseness, meanness (masdar of لَؤُمَ) — lightened: لُومٌ

مَادّ.en: stretching, extending — the active participle of مَدَّ (its origin is مَادِد)

مَبْدَأ.en: a beginning, the place where a thing starts

مَدَار.en: the pivot, what a thing turns upon

مَدَارِيَّة.en: being the pivot — that on which another thing turns

مَدَّة.en: a letter of prolongation — the alif, wāw or yāʾ that only lengthens the vowel before it

مَفْتُون.en: tried, afflicted — the ism mafʿūl of فَتَنَ; here a maṣdar on that measure: «trial, madness»

مَفْعُل.en: the measure mafʿul — not found in their speech without the tāʾ

مَحْمِدَة.en: praise; a praiseworthy trait — a mīm-maṣdar of حَمِدَ

مَحْمُول.en: carried; taken after another word, construed by it (ism mafʿūl of حَمَلَ)

مَهْمُوس.en: whispered, voiceless (of a letter) — the breath runs with it

مَجْهُور.en: voiced (of a letter) — the breath is held with it

مَمَدّ.en: the place or time of stretching — the noun of time and place of مَدَّ (its origin is مَمْدَد)

مَنُوع.en: ever-withholding, most grudging — an intensive on فَعُول

مَعْقُول.en: reasonable, what the mind accepts (ism mafʿūl of عَقَلَ)

مَرْأًى.en: a place of seeing, a sight (ism makān of رَأَى)

مَرَاح.en: a place of repose — where one comes to rest at evening

مَرْكَب.en: a mount; here: what is ridden

مَرْكُوب.en: what is ridden — the ism mafʿūl of رَكِبَ

مَرْتَع.en: pasture, grazing ground (noun of place of رَتَعَ)

مَسْعَاة.en: striving; a noble deed — a mīm-maṣdar of سَعَى

مَصْدُور.en: issued, proceeding (from) — the ism mafʿūl of صَدَرَ

مَشْرُوب.en: what is drunk — the ism mafʿūl of شَرِبَ

مَسْكِن.en: a dwelling — one of the eleven on مَفْعِل against the rule (also مَسْكَن)

مَطْلِع.en: the place (or time) of rising — one of the eleven on مَفْعِل against the rule (also مَطْلَع)

مَوَتَان.en: lifeless things — land and property without life; the opposite of حَيَوَان

مَوْسُوم.en: named, entitled — the ism mafʿūl of وَسَمَ

مَزِيدَة.en: added, augmenting — of a letter that is not a radical (feminine of مَزِيد)

مِيعَد.en: an instrument of promising — the form the rule gives (from مِوْعَد; the wāw turned into a yāʾ after the kasra)

مِجْذَم.en: keen-cutting (of a sword) — on مِفْعَل, a measure shared by the instrument and the intensive

مِجْزَامَة.en: most decisive, quick to cut a matter off — so the printing reads; the lexicons have مِجْذَامَة

مِخْيَاط.en: a needle (an instrument noun on مِفْعَال) — the full form of مِخْيَط

مِخْيَط.en: a needle (an instrument noun on مِفْعَل, shortened from مِخْيَاط)

مِلْح.en: salty (of water) — a ṣifa mushabbaha on فِعْل

مِمَدّ.en: an instrument of stretching — the noun of instrument of مَدَّ (its origin is مِمْدَد)

مِقْوَال.en: a great talker — an intensive on the measure مِفْعَال

مِرْأًى.en: an instrument of seeing — the form the rule gives (the word in use is مِرْآة, a mirror)

مِصْدَاق.en: the criterion, what proves a thing true

مِسْقَام.en: ever ailing, often ill — an intensive on مِفْعَال

مِعْطِير.en: much perfumed, fond of scent — an intensive on مِفْعِيل

مِيَرٌ.en: the matn's example of a hamza with fatḥa after a kasra turned into a yāʾ: مِيَرٌ, from مِئَرٌ (plural of مِئْرَة, enmity)

مُؤَاخَاة.en: brotherhood, pairing as brothers (masdar of آخَى)

مُعَانَقَة.en: embracing, a close joining (masdar of عَانَقَ)

مُبَاعَدَة.en: distance, being far from one another (masdar of بَاعَدَ)

مُفَاعَلَة.en: the mufāʿala — the bāb of فَاعَلَ, named by its masdar

مُفْتَقِر.en: one in need — the ism fāʿil of اِفْتَقَرَ

مُحْوِل.en: a year old, one over whom a year has passed (of a child)

مُعِين.en: a helper — the ism fāʿil of أَعَانَ

مُجْتَلَبَة.en: the brought-in hamza — the hamza of joining fetched to begin on a quiescent letter

مُكَاثَرَة.en: vying in abundance — the maṣdar of كَاثَرَ

مُكْرِم.en: one who honours (ism fāʿil of أَكْرَمَ)

مُنَاسَبَة.en: agreement, fitness between two things (masdar of نَاسَبَ)

مُنْخَفِضَة.en: lowered (of a letter) — the tongue stays low with it; every letter but the elevated seven

مُنْشَعِبَة.en: the branching (bābs) — what is derived from a bare verb by an added letter

مُقَوٍّ.en: one who strengthens — the active participle of قَوَّى

مُرْأًى.en: shown, made to see (ism maf'ul of أَرَى) — lightened: مُرًى

مُرْضِع.en: a nursing mother, one who suckles

مُسَاوَاة.en: equality, being level with one another (masdar of سَاوَى)

مُسْهَب.en: long-winded, prolix — the doer's sense on the object's form, from أَسْهَبَ (irregular)

مُوسِر.en: well-off, a man of means — the active participle of أَيْسَرَ (its origin is مُيْسِر)

مُسْتَحْقِب.en: one who loads up behind him, carrying (active participle of اسْتَحْقَبَ)

مُسْتَعْلِيَة.en: elevated (of a letter) — the tongue rises with it toward the palate

مُسْتَتْبِع.en: that which draws another after it (ism fāʿil of اسْتَتْبَعَ)

مُسْتَتِر.en: concealed (of a pronoun: ism fāʿil of اسْتَتَرَ)

مُتَعَذِّر.en: impossible, not to be managed (ism fāʿil of تَعَذَّرَ)

مُتَدَاخِل.en: interlocking, one entering into another (active participle of form VI)

مُتَوَالِي.en: following one upon another, consecutive (ism fāʿil of تَوَالَى; a manqūṣ noun)

مُطْبَقَة.en: covered (of a letter) — the tongue closes on the palate with it

مُوَافَقَة.en: agreement, matching (masdar of وَافَقَ, Form III)

نَعَقَ.en: to caw, to croak (of a crow)

نَسَّابَة.en: a great genealogist — فَعَّالَة, with the tāʾ of intensity

نَزَوَان.en: leaping, bounding — a maṣdar of نَزَا

نِحْي.en: a skin for clarified butter (dual نِحْيَانِ) — «ذَاتُ النِّحْيَيْنِ»: the woman of the two butter-skins, a byword for one with her hands full

نِشْدَة.en: adjuring, asking in God's name — a maṣdar of نَشَدَ

نُوَمَة.en: a great sleeper — an intensive on the measure فُعَلَة

قَلْنَسَ.en: to put a cap on someone — attached to دَحْرَجَ by a nūn

قَلْسَى.en: to put a cap on someone — attached to دَحْرَجَ by an alif

قَرْدَد.en: hard, raised ground — made to follow جَعْفَر by doubling its dāl

قَوَد.en: retaliation in kind (qiṣāṣ) — kept sound to show its origin

قَاوَمَ.en: to stand up to, to resist

قَوَّمَ.en: to set straight, to correct; to appraise

قَيْلُولَة.en: the midday rest (a maṣdar of قَالَ يَقِيلُ on the measure فَيْعُولَة)

قِدْم.en: the old time — قِدْمًا: of old, long since

قِيتَال.en: fighting — a maṣdar of قَاتَلَ on فِيعَال

قِنْوَة.en: what one acquires and keeps (the base form of قِنْيَة)

قِنْيَة.en: what one acquires and keeps, a possession

قِتَّال.en: fighting — a maṣdar of قَاتَلَ on فِعَّال

رَدِيّ.en: poor, bad — رَدِيء with its hamza softened into the yāʾ (لُغَةٌ رَدِيَّةٌ: a poor dialect)

رَاح.en: the palm of the hand; also wine

رَكَنَ.en: to lean on, to rely on (يَرْكُنُ; the matn cites the mixed رَكَنَ يَرْكَنُ)

رَمْي.en: throwing, a throw — the maṣdar of رَمَى

رَوَّايَة.en: a great transmitter — so the printing reads; the lexicons know رَاوِيَة for this sense

سَبَأَ يَسْبَأُ.en: «سَبَأَ يَسْبَأُ», to buy wine — the matn's example of the hamza-final verb from the bāb of فَتَحَ

صَبَّار.en: most patient, ever-enduring — an intensive on فَعَّال

سَئِمَ.en: to be weary of, to tire of (سَئِمَ يَسْأَمُ)

صَكَك.en: knock-knees — the knees striking each other in walking

صَكّ.en: striking, a blow; also a written deed

سَكْنَة.en: a quiescence, one sukūn — its plural «سَكَنَات» is set beside «حَرَكَات»

صَالِح.en: fit, sound, adequate for a purpose (ism fāʿil of صَلَحَ)

سَالِم.en: Sālim — a man's name; «أُمُّ سَالِمٍ», Umm Sālim

سَمُرَ.en: to be brown (سَمُرَ يَسْمُرُ; سَمِرَ is a dialect form)

سَنَن.en: a way, a course, a single pattern

صَرْفِيّ.en: a morphologist, a scholar of ṣarf

صَرَّاف.en: the practitioner of ṣarf, the morphologist

سَتَشْحَثُكَ خَصَفَهْ.en: the words that gather the ten whispered letters (س ت ش ح ث ك خ ص ف ه)

صَوَرَى.en: Ṣawarā — the name of a water

سَوَّى.en: to make equal, to treat alike (سُوِّيَ بَيْنَهُمَا: the two were made alike)

سَيْدُودَة.en: lordship, being a chief (a maṣdar of سَادَ; wāw-rooted, on the measure فَيْعُولَة)

شَدَّدَ.en: to double a letter — to say it with a shadda; to strengthen

شَفَوِيّ.en: labial — of the lips (the nisba of شَفَة)

شَمْلَلَ.en: to hasten — attached to دَحْرَجَ by a repeated lām

شَطْء.en: the shoot of a plant, its first sprout

شَيَّبَ.en: to turn (someone's hair) grey, to age (Form II)

سِدْس.en: the origin of «سِتّ» (six) before its sīn and dāl were made a tāʾ

صِرَاف.en: (a she-dog's) being in heat — a maṣdar of صَرَفَتْ

صُهُوبَة.en: reddishness (of the hair) — a maṣdar of صَهِبَ

سُرّ.en: the navel-cord — what is cut from the newborn's navel

تَعَانَقَ.en: to embrace one another; (of words) to cling together (Form VI)

تَعَيُّن.en: being singled out, being fixed for one thing (masdar of تَعَيَّنَ, Form V)

تَبَع.en: following, going after (تَبَعًا لِكَذَا: in keeping with it)

تَبَخْتَرَ.en: to strut, to walk with a proud sway (tafaʿlala)

وَزْنُ تَفَاعُلٍ.en: the measure tafāʿul — the masdar of the bāb تَفَاعَلَ

تَفَضَّلَ.en: to be gracious, to do a favour

وَزْنُ تَفَعُّلٍ.en: the measure tafaʿʿul — the masdar of the bāb تَفَعَّلَ

تَفْعِيل.en: tafʿīl — the masdar measure of the second bāb (فَعَّلَ يُفَعِّلُ) and that bāb's name

تَهْدَار.en: much roaring, much babbling — the intensive maṣdar of هَدَرَ

تَحْمِيل.en: loading, laying a burden on (masdar of حَمَّلَ) — here: making a letter bear a vowel

تَحْرِيك.en: giving a letter a vowel (maṣdar of حَرَّكَ)

تَجَلْبَبَ.en: to put on a jilbāb — attached to تَدَحْرَجَ

تَجَاوَرَ.en: to be neighbours to one another

تَجَوْرَبَ.en: to put on socks — attached to تَدَحْرَجَ

تَلْعَاب.en: much playing — the intensive maṣdar of لَعِبَ

طَلَل.en: the standing trace of a dwelling (pl. أَطْلَال)

تَلْيِين.en: softening — lightening the hamza by turning it toward a weak letter (masdar of لَيَّنَ)

تَمَسْكَنَ.en: to show oneself poor and lowly — attached to تَدَحْرَجَ

تَقَضِّي.en: swooping down (of a bird of prey) — its origin is تَقَضُّض; the last ḍād was turned into a yāʾ

تَقَلَّدَ.en: to gird oneself with, to take upon oneself (a sword, an office) (Form V)

تَقْدِيرِيّ.en: estimated, taqdīrī — of an iʿrāb assumed at an end that cannot show it

طَرَفِيّ.en: at the edge, final (nisba to طَرَف)

تَرَهْوَكَ.en: to walk with a loose, swaying gait — attached to تَدَحْرَجَ

طَرَقَ.en: to come to by night; to knock

تَصْغِير.en: the diminutive; making small (masdar of صَغَّرَ)

تَشَيْطَنَ.en: to behave like a devil — attached to تَدَحْرَجَ

تَسْكِين.en: making a letter quiescent (masdar of سَكَّنَ)

تَطَهَّرَ.en: to purify oneself (tafaʿʿala of طَهُرَ — also اِطَّهَّرَ, the tāʾ merged into the ṭāʾ with a hamza brought in)

تَثَاقَلَ.en: to be sluggish, to hang back (tafāʿala of ثَقُلَ — also اِثَّاقَلَ)

تَوَالٍ.en: coming one after another, an unbroken run (masdar of تَوَالَى, Form VI)

تَعْوِيض.en: compensating, putting one thing in place of another (masdar of عَوَّضَ)

طَيّ.en: Ṭayyiʾ — an Arab tribe (طَيِّئ, written طَيّ with the hamza lightened)

ثَمَّةَ.en: there — a mabnī ẓarf of place; مِنْ ثَمَّةَ: from there, hence

تِبْيَان.en: making clear, exposition — a maṣdar on the measure تِفْعَال

تِحِمَّال.en: bearing, taking upon oneself — a maṣdar of تَحَمَّلَ on تِفِعَّال

تُكْلَان.en: reliance, trust — a maṣdar of وَكَلَ whose wāw was replaced by a tāʾ at the head

طُرُوّ.en: supervening, coming upon a thing from outside (masdar of طَرَأَ, lightened from طُرُوء)

طُوَّال.en: very tall — an intensive on فُعَّال

أُفَيِّسٌ.en: the matn's example of a hamza behind the yāʾ of the diminutive turned into a yāʾ and merged: أُفَيِّسٌ, from أُفَيْئِسٌ (the diminutive of أَفْؤُس, plural of فَأْس, an axe)

وَدُود.en: the All-Loving — one of God's names

وَاغِل.en: one who comes to a drinking party uninvited, an intruder

وَاعِد.en: one who promises (ism fāʿil of وَعَدَ)

وَجَأَ.en: to strike, to stab (mithāl: وَجَأَ يَجَأُ)

وَجِيف.en: a quick pace; a throbbing (of the heart) — a maṣdar of وَجَفَ

وَقَرَ.en: to be staid, to sit still, to be dignified (وَقَرَ يَقِرُ وَقَارًا)

وَرَنْتَل.en: «warantal»: hardship, a grave affair (also said to be a place-name) — the word the ṣarf books cite for a wāw that opens a word as a RADICAL

وَرْطَة.en: a plight, a place of ruin with no easy way out

وَاوِيّ.en: wāw-rooted — having a wāw among its root letters

وَازَى.en: to stand level with, to be parallel to

وُعِل.en: the mountain goat — a rare word on the measure فُعِل (a variant of وَعِل)

يَبَدِّلُ.en: the matn's example of merging the tāʾ of iftiʿāl into a dāl: يَبَدِّلُ, from يَبْتَدِلُ

يَبَطِّرُ.en: the matn's example of merging the tāʾ of iftiʿāl into a ṭāʾ: يَبَطِّرُ, from يَبْتَطِرُ

يَافِع.en: a youth grown tall, near to manhood — from أَيْفَعَ, on فَاعِل against the rule

يَائِيّ.en: yāʾ-rooted — having a yāʾ among its root letters

يَنَعَ.en: to ripen — of fruit (mithāl with a yāʾ: يَنَعَ يَيْنَعُ)

يُهَرِيقُ.en: «he pours out» — the muḍāriʿ of هَرَاقَ, cited: its hāʾ stands where the hamza of أَرَاقَ stood, kept against analogy

يُرِيقُ.en: «he pours out» — the muḍāriʿ of أَرَاقَ (Form IV, hollow), cited as the origin of «يُهَرِيقُ»

اِبْتَنَى.en: to build upon (passive: to be built)

دَفَّة.en: a cover, one board of a binding

جَامِعَة.en: gathering, joining two things (ism fa'il, fem.)

مُسْتَغْرِق.en: taking in the whole of (ism fa'il, Form X)

صَلَحَ.en: to be fit for, to be suitable

تَرَجَّحَ.en: to be given the stronger weight

تَأَمُّل.en: reflection, thinking a thing over (masdar, Form V)

نَسْخ.en: abrogation — the lifting of a ruling by a later one (masdar)

مُشْكِل.en: the DIFFICULT — reached only by searching

مُجْمِل.en: the one who left it summed up (ism fa'il)

عِبَارَة.en: the plain wording — what the speech was said FOR (masdar)

اقْتِضَاء.en: requirement — what must be supplied for the speech to stand (masdar, Form VIII)

اجْتِهَاد.en: a jurist's reasoned effort (masdar, Form VIII)

إِطْلَاق.en: coming unqualified, without an indication (masdar, Form IV)

نَدْب.en: recommendation — a request that does not bind (masdar)

إِبَاحَة.en: permission — leave to do or not do (masdar, Form IV)

نَابَ.en: to stand in for, to take the place of

اِنْقَسَمَ.en: to divide into, to fall into kinds

مُخَصِّص.en: the SPECIFIER — what cuts a general down (ism fa'il)

مُنْضَبِط.en: well defined — having a bound it does not exceed (ism fa'il, Form VII)

مُقَدَّرَات.en: the fixed amounts — what the Lawgiver settled by number or measure

عَزِيمَة.en: the strict rule — what was laid down with no excuse in view

شَرَعَ.en: to legislate, to lay down as law

مِقْلَاع.en: a sling — the shepherd's stone-thrower (pl. مَقَالِيع)

طَالُوتُ.en: Ṭālūt (Saul) — the king chosen for the Children of Israel; a diptote (a foreign proper name)

الزَّبُور.en: the Zabūr — the Book sent down to Dāwūd

غَشَّ.en: to cheat, to deceive (doubled: غَشَّ يَغُشُّ)

شِرَاء.en: buying, purchase (maṣdar of اِشْتَرَى; also of شَرَى)

أَمَالِي.en: amali — dictated lessons (plural of imla'); here, the poem's name

مُعَلًّى.en: raised high (Form II passive participle, maqsur)

اِرْتِحَال.en: departing, the great removal (Form VIII masdar)

اِنْعِزَال.en: being removed from office (Form VII masdar)

لَمْ.en: did not (negates, apocopates, flips to past)

مِكْثَار.en: one given to excess of talk (a mif'al mubalagha)

غَالٍ (الْغَالِي).en: overstepping the bound (ism fa'il of غَلَا)

مُقَلِّد.en: muqallid — one who follows without the proof

نَصْل.en: blade — of a sword or arrow

اِخْتِزَال.en: seizing another's wealth — theft or usurpation

مَآل.en: final outcome (mimi masdar of آلَ); the hereafter

عِنَب.en: grapes (a collective; the unit noun is عِنَبَة)

بَطُّوطَة.en: Baṭṭūṭa — in ابْنُ بَطُّوطَةَ, the name by which the Moroccan traveller Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad al-Lawātī al-Ṭanjī (703–after 770 AH) is known; a diptote

حُمَّى.en: fever (a maqṣūr noun with the feminine alif)

الْإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّة.en: Alexandria — the Egyptian port city on the Mediterranean

جُزَيّ.en: Juzayy — in ابْنُ جُزَيٍّ, Muḥammad ibn Juzayy al-Kalbī, the Andalusian scholar and secretary who wrote down Ibn Baṭṭūṭa's Riḥla

طَنْجَة.en: Tangier — the port city at the Strait, Ibn Baṭṭūṭa's birthplace (a diptote: a feminine proper name)

أَسْوَأ.en: worse, the worst (elative of سَيِّئ; diptote)

هَابِيل.en: Habil (Abel) — the righteous son of Adam (diptote: a foreign proper name)

حَسُود.en: envious, given to envy (intensive adjective on فَعُول)

حُفْرَة.en: a pit, a hole dug in the ground

قَابِيل.en: Qabil (Cain) — the son of Adam who killed his brother (diptote: a foreign proper name)

قَسَمَ.en: to divide, to apportion, to allot (bāb ḍaraba: قَسَمَ يَقْسِمُ)

قُرْبَان.en: an offering, a sacrifice brought near to God

أَلْب.en: Alp — Turkish «hero, valiant»: the first word of the name Alp Arslan (spoken with a quiescent end; the case shows on أَرْسَلَان)

أَلْب أَرْسَلَان.en: Alp Arslan — the Seljuk sultan (r. 455–465 / 1063–1072), victor of Manzikert (463 / 1071)

أَرْمَانُوس.en: Romanos IV Diogenes, Byzantine emperor (r. 1068–1071) — أَرْمَانُوس in the Arabic chronicles; a diptote (ʿalamiyya + ʿujma)

أَرْسَلَان.en: Arslan — Turkish «lion»: the second word of the name Alp Arslan; a diptote (a proper name of foreign origin: ʿalamiyya + ʿujma)

ابْنُ الْأَثِيرِ.en: Ibn al-Athīr — ʿIzz al-Dīn ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad (d. 630 / 1233), the historian, author of al-Kāmil fī al-Taʾrīkh

حَوَّاء.en: Hawwa (Eve) — the wife of Adam (diptote: a name ending in the long alif of the feminine)

تَكْرِيم.en: honouring, showing honour (maṣdar of كَرَّمَ, form II)

أَطْفَأَ.en: to put out, to extinguish (a lamp, a fire) — Form IV, its last radical a hamza

ابْنُ خَلْدُونَ.en: Ibn Khaldūn — ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad (732–808 / 1332–1406), the Maghribī historian and judge, author of the Muqaddima

خَلْدُون.en: Khaldūn — the forefather after whom the family of Ibn Khaldūn was named; read in its usual vowelling as a diptote (ابْنُ خَلْدُونَ), though some decline it

تَيْمُور.en: Tīmūr (Tamerlane, d. 807 / 1405), the conqueror from Central Asia; a diptote (a proper name of foreign origin: ʿalamiyya + ʿujma)

مُعْرِب.en: one who parses, who gives the iʿrab (ism fāʿil of أَعْرَبَ)

لَاء.en: the name of the letter lā, lengthened — لَاءُ النَّهْيِ

اِمْتِنَاع.en: not coming about, being prevented (masdar of اِمْتَنَعَ)

عُقَيْل.en: ʿUqayl — the Arab tribe in whose dialect لَعَلَّ governs jarr

الْمُسْتَثْنَى.en: the excepted thing (ism mafʿūl of اِسْتَثْنَى)

لَغْو.en: idle, void — ظَرْفٌ لَغْوٌ: the phrase hanging on a stated verb

كَيْمَهْ.en: «why?» — كَيْ governing the interrogative مَا (its alif dropped) with the hāʾ of pause

وَسْط.en: amid, in the midst of — with a sukūn on the sīn, a ẓarf of place

فَرْسَخ.en: a farsakh — about three miles (a measure of distance)

مَضْرَب.en: the striking-place (a noun of place on مَفْعَل)

مُعَلَّل.en: explained by a cause (ism mafʿūl of عَلَّلَ) — the verb a mafʿūl lah gives the reason for

مَحَلِّيّ.en: of place — الْإِعْرَابُ الْمَحَلِّيُّ: the iʿrāb a word holds by its place, not its wording

نَائِبِيَّة.en: deputyhood — being the deputy of the doer

إِيصَال.en: connection (masdar of أَوْصَلَ) — الْحَذْفُ وَالْإِيصَالُ: the letter dropped and the verb reaching the noun

شُذُوذ.en: irregularity (masdar of شَذَّ) — عَلَى الشُّذُوذِ: as an irregular case

تَعَلُّق.en: hanging on, attachment (masdar of تَعَلَّقَ) — of a jarr phrase on its governor

عَرِيّ.en: bare, stripped of (عَرِيٌّ عَنْ) — a ṣifa mushabbaha

مَصْدَرِيّ.en: maṣdar-making (a nisba) — of مَا and أَنْ

تَوْقِيتِيّ.en: of time, timing (a nisba) — مَا التَّوْقِيتِيَّة: as long as

عَاطِف.en: joining, conjunctive (ism fāʿil of عَطَفَ) — حَرْفٌ عَاطِفٌ

مُشْتَبِه.en: resembling (ism fāʿil of اشْتَبَهَ); الْمُشْتَبِهُ بِالْمُضَافِ: لَا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَيْدٍ

مُعْتَمِد.en: leaning on, depending on (ism fāʿil of اعْتَمَدَ)

إِضْمَار.en: concealing — leaving a governor unspoken but intended (masdar of أَضْمَرَ)

حَيْثُمَا.en: wherever — a conditional ẓarf of place

إِذْمَا.en: whenever — إِذْ with مَا, a conditional letter

مَا (الشَّرْطِيَّة).en: whatever — the conditional mā that jazms two verbs

مَحْصُور.en: bounded, confined to a number (ism mafʿūl of حَصَرَ)

مُبَايِن.en: different, distinct from (ism fāʿil of بَايَنَ)

مُتَّحِد.en: one and the same, united (ism fāʿil of اتَّحَدَ)

عَدِمَ.en: to lack, to miss, to be without (bāb سَمِعَ)

تَعْلِيق.en: the taʿlīq — suspending a verb's work in wording while it stands in sense (masdar of عَلَّقَ)

عَمَّ.en: to be general over, to include all (doubled; عَمَّ يَعُمُّ)

أَعْلَمَ.en: to inform someone of something (Form IV; three objects: أَعْلَمَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا بَكْرًا فَاضِلًا)

مُتَبَادِر.en: what first comes to mind (ism fāʿil of تَبَادَرَ)

كَمُلَ.en: to be complete, to come to perfection (bāb حَسُنَ)

هَلْهَلَ.en: to be about to, to set about (a verb of approach; quadriliteral)

عَلِقَ.en: to cling to; to begin to (a verb of beginning)

ضُوَيْرِب.en: a little striker — the diminutive of ḍārib (quoted as a word)

مُضَيْرِب.en: a little struck one — the diminutive of maḍrūb (quoted as a word)

رِطْل.en: a pound (raṭl, a measure of weight)

هٰذَيْنِ.en: these two (the dual demonstrative in naṣb and jarr)

دُونَكَ.en: dūnaka! — «take!», «here, take it!» (a ẓarf turned noun-verb of command)

هَا (اسْمُ فِعْلٍ).en: hā! — «take!» (a noun-verb of command: هَا زَيْدًا)

حَيَّهَلَ.en: ḥayyahala! — «come to!», «hurry to!» (a compound noun-verb of command)

مَنْسُوب.en: the nisba noun — related to (ism mafʿūl of نَسَبَ, the noun with the yāʾ of relation)

مُنْتَقِل.en: moved over, transferred (ism fāʿil of انْتَقَلَ)

سَرْعَانَ.en: sarʿāna! — «how quickly!» (a noun-verb with a past sense: it was quick, it drew near)

شَتَّانَ.en: shattāna! — «how different!», «the two have parted» (a noun-verb with a past sense)

وَشْكَانَ.en: washkāna! — «how soon!» (a noun-verb with a past sense: it was soon, it drew near)

مَوْقِع.en: place, position (the noun of place of وَقَعَ)

تَجَرُّد.en: being stripped, bareness (maṣdar of تَجَرَّدَ) — in nahw: a word's freedom from lafẓī governors

مَنْصُوبَة.en: in the accusative (feminine of manṣūb) — مَنْصُوبَةُ الْمَحَلِّ

مَسَدّ.en: the place filled — سَدَّ مَسَدَّهُ: to fill its place, stand in for it

سَادّ.en: filling, standing in (ism fāʿil of سَدَّ) — سَادٌّ مَسَدَّ الْخَبَرِ

مَقُول.en: what is said — مَقُولُ الْقَوْلِ: the sentence that is the object of «said»

مُعَيْدِيّ.en: the Muʿaydī — the little man of Maʿadd in the proverb «to hear of the Muʿaydī is better than to see him»

مَجْزُومَة.en: in the jussive (feminine of majzūm) — مَجْزُومَةُ الْمَحَلِّ

مَتْبُوع.en: the word followed (matbūʿ) — what a follower takes its iʿrāb from

مُعَلَّق.en: suspended (ism mafʿūl of عَلَّقَ) — the clause a verb of the heart is suspended from

مُسْتَقِرّ.en: settled — the ẓarf hanging on a dropped general verb (ism fāʿil of اسْتَقَرَّ)

مُظْهَر.en: shown, an apparent noun as against the pronoun (ism mafʿūl of أَظْهَرَ)

بَوَاقٍ.en: the remaining ones (plural of بَاقٍ) — الْبَوَاقِي: the rest of the forms

إِزَاء.en: opposite, facing — بِإِزَائِهِ: as its counterpart

جَائِي.en: coming (ism fāʿil of جَاءَ) — جَائِيَة، جَاؤُونَ، جَائِيَات

مُخَصَّص.en: particularised — a nakira narrowed by a description or an annexation (ism mafʿūl of خَصَّصَ)

رَافِع.en: raising — the governor that puts a word in rafʿ (ism fāʿil of رَفَعَ)

مُلَاقٍ.en: meeting, one who meets (active participle of form III)

مَضْمُون.en: content, what is contained — the meaning a governor carries

مُصَاحِب.en: accompanying, accompanied (active participle of form III)

رَابِط.en: a binder — the pronoun or wāw tying a clause to its owner

إِبْهَام.en: vagueness, obscurity — what the tamyīz lifts

مُفَجَّر.en: burst open, made to gush (passive participle of form II)

مُمْتَلِئ.en: full, filled (active participle of form VIII)

مَخْفُوض.en: in the genitive (khafḍ = jarr, the Kūfan term)

نَوَّنَ.en: to give a word tanwīn (form II)

نُدُور.en: rarity — usage against the rule, heard but not reasoned from

تَيْم.en: Taym — a tribal name (Taym of ʿAdī)

أَمْرِيَّة.en: of command (a sentence of the imperative)

أَرْضَعَ.en: to suckle, to nurse a child (form IV)

إِنْشَائِيَّة.en: performative (of a sentence) — commanding, asking, praying, not stating

نَهْيِيَّة.en: of prohibition (a sentence of the prohibitive)

تَعَاسَرَ.en: to make things hard for one another, to be at odds (form VI)

إِلَخْ.en: etc. — the abbreviation of إِلَى آخِرِهِ «to its end»

أُسَامَة.en: Usāma — the lion's genus-name, also a man's name

ذَانِّكَ.en: dhānnika — «those two» (masculine dual, far, the nūn doubled)

كَ.en: the kāf of address — a suffixed particle varying with the addressee (dhāka, dhākum)

تَانِّكَ.en: tānnika — «those two» (feminine dual, far, the nūn doubled)

أُولَالِكَ.en: ulālika — «those» (plural, far, with the lām of distance)

جَارّ.en: the jarr-governor — the particle of jarr as governor

خَافِض.en: the jarr-governor — the particle or muḍāf that lowers the noun (Kūfan term)

أَبْصَع.en: abṣaʿu — a follower of ajmaʿu in tawkīd

أَبْتَع.en: abtaʿu — a follower of ajmaʿu in tawkīd

أَكْتَع.en: aktaʿu — a follower of ajmaʿu in tawkīd

مُرَادِف.en: a synonym (active participle of form III)

أَوْرَدَ.en: to bring forward, to adduce (form IV)

مُبْدَل.en: substituted — the mubdal minhu is the word the badal stands for

تَشَوَّقَ.en: to long for, to yearn (form V)

بُصَعَ.en: buṣaʿa — plural of baṣʿāʾ, follower of jumaʿa (diptote)

بُتَعَ.en: butaʿa — plural of batʿāʾ, follower of jumaʿa (diptote)

جُمَعَ.en: jumaʿa — «all», plural of jamʿāʾ, a tawkīd word (diptote)

كُتَعَ.en: kutaʿa — plural of katʿāʾ, follower of jumaʿa (diptote)

مَرْبَعَ.en: marbaʿa — «four by four», a deflected numeral (diptote)

مَثْلَثَ.en: mathlatha — «three by three», a deflected numeral (diptote)

مَثْنَى.en: mathnā — «two by two», a deflected numeral (diptote)

مَوْحَدَ.en: mawḥada — «one by one», a deflected numeral (diptote)

قُزَحُ.en: Quzaḥ — the name in qaws Quzaḥ, the rainbow (diptote)

رُبَاعَ.en: rubāʿa — «four by four», a deflected numeral (diptote)

ثُلَاثَ.en: thulātha — «three by three», a deflected numeral (diptote)

ثُنَاءَ.en: thunāʾa — «two by two», a deflected numeral (diptote)

أُحَادَ.en: uḥāda — «one by one», a deflected numeral (diptote)

زُفَرُ.en: Zufar — a man's name on the pattern fuʿal (diptote)

قَالُونُ.en: Qālūn — the name of Nāfiʿ's transmitter; a foreign word (diptote)

شَمَّرَ.en: to roll up (sleeves), to gird oneself (form II) — cited as a verb-pattern

شَتَرُ.en: Shatar — a place-name; foreign, three-lettered with a vowelled middle (diptote)

يَشْكُرُ.en: Yashkur — a tribal name on a muḍāriʿ pattern (diptote)

بَعْلَبَكُّ.en: Baʿlabakk — a town; a compound name (diptote)

فَعَالِيل.en: the pattern faʿālīl — the plural of plurals with a long third, a diptote (maṣābīḥ)

حَضْرَمَوْتُ.en: Ḥaḍramawt — a region; a compound name (diptote)

حَمْزَةُ.en: Ḥamza — a man's name with the feminine tāʾ (diptote)

مَنْع.en: barring, prevention — the maṣdar of manaʿa; manʿ al-ṣarf

سَلَاسِل.en: chains — the plural of silsila, on faʿālil

صَرْف.en: declension — taking tanwīn and kasra; the opposite of manʿ

عَلَمِيَّة.en: name-hood, the quality of being a proper name

مَحْكِيّ.en: cited, quoted as it was (of an iʿrāb or form carried into a name)

تَأَبَّطَ.en: to put under one's arm (form V) — Taʾabbaṭa Sharran, a poet's name

مُشْتَغِل.en: busy, occupied with (active participle of ishtaghala, form VIII)

أَيَّة.en: ayya — the feminine of ayy; declined, like ayy, among the relatives

حَذَامِ.en: Ḥadhāmi — a woman's name on faʿāli, built on kasra by the Ḥijāz

حَادِي.en: ḥādī — «first» as the first part of the ordinal eleventh (ḥādī ʿashara)

حَادِيَة.en: ḥādiya — the feminine of ḥādī in ḥādiyata ʿashrata

لَدْ.en: lad — a shortened form of ladun, «at, with»

قَطُّ.en: qaṭṭu — «ever» of the past (with a negative), built on ḍamma

اِسْتِغَاثَة.en: istighātha — the call for help (yā la-zaydin); form X maṣdar

نُدْبَة.en: nudba — the lament over one lost (wā zaydāh)

أَيْ.en: ay — a particle of calling, for the near

هَيَا.en: hayā — a particle of calling, for the distant

وَا.en: wā — the particle of the lament (nudba): wā zaydāh

بَرِيد.en: a post-stage — four farsakhs; the post

الْبُخَارِيّ.en: al-Bukhārī — Imam Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Bukhārī (d. 256 / 870), compiler of the Ṣaḥīḥ; a nisba to Bukhārā

ابْنُ حَجَرٍ.en: Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī (d. 852 / 1449), the great commentator on al-Bukhārī's Ṣaḥīḥ (Fatḥ al-Bārī, whose introduction is Hady al-Sārī)

إِسْنَاد.en: the chain of transmitters of a ḥadīth, its isnād (pl. أَسَانِيد)

أَفْقَه.en: more / most learned in fiqh (elative of فَقِيه; a diptote)

أَنَس.en: Anas — Anas ibn Mālik (d. c. 93 AH), the servant of the Prophet ﷺ and one of the last Companions to die

أَقْدَر.en: more able, better able (elative of قَادِر; a diptote)

عَطَاء.en: ʿAṭāʾ — a man's name («a gift»); here ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ (d. 114 AH), the jurist of Mecca

الْفُرْس.en: the Persians (a collective name of the people)

هُبَيْرَة.en: Hubayra — in the name of Ibn Hubayra: Yazīd ibn ʿUmar ibn Hubayra (d. 132 AH), the last Umayyad governor of Iraq

إِدْرِيس.en: Idrīs — a man's name (a foreign name, a diptote)

الْعِجْلِيّ.en: al-ʿIjlī — Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-ʿIjlī (d. 261 AH), the Kufan ḥadīth critic; a nisba to the Banū ʿIjl

إِمَامَة.en: leadership, the rank of an imam (masdar of أَمَّ)

اِتَّهَمَ.en: to accuse, to suspect (someone of something, with بِ) — Form VIII of و ه م

عِيَال.en: dependants — those whom a man feeds and keeps (plural of عَيِّل)

كَابُل.en: Kābul — the city of Kābul (a foreign place-name, a diptote)

خَزّ.en: khazz — a cloth woven of silk, or of wool and silk

خَزَّاز.en: a khazzāz — a dealer in khazz cloth (فَعَّال of a trade)

مَعِين.en: Maʿīn — in the name of Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn (d. 233 AH), the imam of ḥadīth criticism

مَسْقِيّ.en: given to drink (ism mafʿūl of سَقَى); here: made to drink poison

الْمُبَارَك.en: al-Mubārak — in the name of Ibn al-Mubārak: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mubārak (d. 181 AH), the imam of Marw

مُحْرِز.en: Muḥriz — a man's name; here in the name of Ibn Muḥriz, who transmitted Ibn Maʿīn's judgements

مُجَلَّد.en: a bound volume (ism mafʿūl of جَلَّدَ «to bind»)

مُقْرِئ.en: a teacher of Qurʾān recitation (ism fāʿil of أَقْرَأَ); printed here with its hamza lightened, الْمُقْرِي — the byname of Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd (d. 213 AH)

مُسَلَّم.en: handed over, conceded, granted without dispute (ism mafʿūl of سَلَّمَ)

النَّضْر.en: al-Naḍr — a man's name; here al-Naḍr ibn Muḥammad al-Marwazī, a student of Abū Ḥanīfa

نَسَا.en: Nasā — a town of Khurāsān (a diptote ending in alif)

النُّعْمَان.en: al-Nuʿmān — the given name of Abū Ḥanīfa: al-Nuʿmān ibn Thābit (80–150 AH), the imam of Kufa

قَفْل.en: Qafl — the Banū Qafl, a clan (so vowelled in the edition)

قَلَنْسُوَة.en: a qalansuwa — a tall cap worn on the head (its nūn and wāw are added letters)

الرَّبِيع.en: al-Rabīʿ — a man's name; here al-Rabīʿ ibn Yūnus (d. c. 169 AH), the chamberlain (ḥājib) of the caliph al-Manṣūr

رَكْعَة.en: a rakʿa — one cycle of the prayer (a noun of one act, from رَكَعَ)

سَبْعُونَ.en: seventy (declines like the sound masculine plural: سَبْعِينَ)

الشَّعْبِيّ.en: al-Shaʿbī — ʿĀmir ibn Sharāḥīl (d. c. 104 AH), the great Successor and judge of Kufa

الشَّافِعِيّ.en: al-Shāfiʿī — the imam Muḥammad ibn Idrīs al-Shāfiʿī (150–204 AH)

تَضَرُّع.en: humble entreaty, lowly supplication (masdar of تَضَرَّعَ, Form V)

تَيْمِيّ.en: a Taymī — of the tribe of Taym (a nisba); here of Taym Allāh ibn Thaʿlaba, by clientage

ثَعْلَبَة.en: Thaʿlaba — a man's name with the feminine tāʾ (a diptote); Taym Allāh ibn Thaʿlaba is a clan of Bakr ibn Wāʾil

تِرْمِذ.en: Tirmidh — a town on the river Jayḥūn (the Oxus); so vowelled in the edition

وَلَاء.en: walāʾ — clientage: the tie that binds a freed slave to the one who freed him and to that man's clan

الزَّيَّات.en: al-Zayyāt «the oil-seller» — the byname of Ḥamza ibn Ḥabīb (d. 156 AH), the Kufan reader of the Qurʾān; on فَعَّال, the pattern of a trade

الزُّهْرِيّ.en: al-Zuhrī — a nisba to the Banū Zuhra; here Isḥāq ibn Ibrāhīm al-Zuhrī

زُوطَى.en: Zūṭā — Abū Ḥanīfa's grandfather, a man of Kābul; a foreign name ending in alif maqṣūra, so its case-vowels are estimated (the edition vowels the zāy with ḍamma; Zawṭā is also transmitted)
